title: Why Highway Guardrails Have Heavy End Boxes 🤯
topic: Why highway guardrail ends feature a heavy steel box designed to flatten and redirect guardrail beams during a crash.
claims: Guardrail end terminals (extruder terminals) flatten and curl steel W-beams upon impact.
Plastic deformation of the guardrail absorbs the kinetic energy of a crashing vehicle.
Extruder terminals are engineered to redirect the flattened beam away from the roadway to prevent vehicle spearing.

title: Why Your Funny Bone Shocks You ⚡
topic: Why bumping your elbow's funny bone triggers an intense electrical shock down your forearm.
claims: The ulnar nerve runs close to the surface at the elbow joint.
Impact on the ulnar nerve produces a tingling or electric shock sensation down the forearm.
Lack of thick muscle and fat padding over the ulnar nerve at the elbow makes it vulnerable to direct compression.
